args.description: Big-headed soldier ant (major worker caste): its square armored head is enormous, as big as its whole thorax and abdomen together, with two huge dark curved crushing mandibles, small body behind the giant head, red-brown armor, thick legs, side view, facing left. Game monster sprite, full body, the whole creature visible, plain transparent background. Bold dark outline, 16-bit JRPG pixel art, same art style as the reference ant monster. Only the monster: no visual effects, no glow, no sparks, no flashes, no particles, no slash marks, no humans, no people, no characters, no text.
